paragraphs.text: Customer Due Diligence Policy
Version 3.2 - Compliance Division
1. Purpose
This policy sets the minimum customer due diligence (CDD) standards for all branches and digital channels.
2. Scope
The policy applies to all employees, agents and outsourced staff who open or maintain customer accounts.
3. Standard Due Diligence
Staff must verify the identity of every new customer using a valid KTP or passport before the account is opened.
Customer information must be updated periodically.
4. Enhanced Due Diligence
Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.
Enhanced due diligence cases must be approved by the branch manager and the compliance officer.
5. Record Keeping
All CDD records must be kept for at least 5 years after the business relationship ends.
6. Reporting
Suspicious transactions must be reported to PPATK within 3 working days of detection.
Staff must not inform the customer that a report has been filed.
7. Review
This policy will be reviewed annually by the Compliance Division.

Staff must verify the identity of every new customer using a valid KTP or passport before the account is opened.

Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

All CDD records must be kept for at least 5 years after the business relationship ends.

Suspicious transactions must be reported to PPATK within 3 working days of detection.

This policy will be reviewed annually by the Compliance Division.
